initial_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I get up + optional time / purpose / circumstance. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I get up at six thirty. Visual staging: An adult putting on slippers while leaving bed. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
2. Meaning: I get up and open the window. Visual staging: An adult leaving bed and opening a bedroom window. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
3. Meaning: I get up early for school. Visual staging: An adult getting out of bed with a school bag ready nearby. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
4. Meaning: I get up slowly on weekends. Visual staging: An adult slowly getting out of bed on a relaxed morning. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
5. Meaning: I get up as soon as my alarm rings. Visual staging: An adult swinging their feet out of bed beside a ringing alarm. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
6. Meaning: I get up before everyone else in the house. Visual staging: An adult leaving bed while other bedroom doors remain closed. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
7. Meaning: I get up to feed the baby. Visual staging: A parent leaving bed and walking toward a baby crib. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
8. Meaning: I get up without waking my sister. Visual staging: Two adult sisters in separate beds; one, wearing loose full-coverage clothes and hijab, quietly steps into slippers while the other sleeps under an opaque blanket. No men, shared bed or exposed body. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
9. Meaning: I get up and make a cup of tea. Visual staging: An adult in morning clothes moving from a bedroom toward a kitchen. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
10. Meaning: I get up later when I have a day off. Visual staging: An adult slowly leaving bed in a bright late-morning room. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
11. Meaning: I get up at five to catch the first bus. Visual staging: A commuter leaving bed before dawn with a travel bag ready. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
12. Meaning: I get up ten minutes after I wake up. Visual staging: An awake adult finally putting on slippers beside the bed. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.


Composition priority: Canvas is a 3:4 portrait rectangle, twelve equally sized SQUARE cells. In panels 1, 4, 5, 10 and 12, show the adult clearly beginning to leave the bed: feet placed into opaque slippers on the floor and torso sitting up or rising, rather than lying awake. All legs covered by loose full-length garments. Panel 1 may include an analog clock with minute hand down and hour hand between six and seven for 6:30. Panel 11 clock hands at 5:00 (minute up, hour lower right). Panel 7 is a fully clothed father rising and moving toward an infant crib, with bottle on a nearby table; no feeding exposure. Panel 8 shows ONLY two adult sisters in separate beds; the rising sister wears opaque hijab, long loose sleeves and full-length trousers, the sleeping sister covered by a blanket. Panel 9 show someone who has risen, standing in a kitchen doorway preparing tea, bed glimpsed behind. All scenes warm photorealism, ordinary Arab home, no overlaid text or digits, no bare or tight clothing. Do not add extra cells.
edit_prompt: Edit this 3-column, 4-row, twelve-SQUARE-cell educational photo atlas. Make ONLY the modest clothing correction: in every panel where a person is seated at or rising from a bed, add loose opaque FULL-LENGTH ankle-covering trousers beneath the thobe or dress, reaching all the way to the slippers, with socks as needed. Cover ALL visible lower legs and ankles, including the men in cells 1, 4, 5, 10, 11 and 12 and the woman in cell 8. No bare calf, shin, knee, thigh or ankle anywhere. Keep the exact same scenes, people, facial expressions, hand actions, clock hands, room lighting, panel order and square geometry. Keep the canvas width:height exactly THREE:FOUR (3:4), not narrow 1:2; keep exactly twelve square cells with thin continuous straight white dividers. No new text, numbers, logos or extra panels. All adults remain in loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck clothes; women keep opaque hijab. Do not change or remove the baby crib, tea-making scene, closed hallway doors or school bag.
